patterns.note: A two-column main content area with a persistent right sidebar for supplementary information and FAQs, which scrolls with the main content.
A two-tiered sticky header, where both the primary logo/search bar and the secondary navigation links remain fixed at the top of the viewport upon scroll.
High-contrast dark mode palette featuring deep blues as primary backgrounds, white text, and vibrant yellow-orange for calls-to-action and key highlights.
Content sections are visually separated by subtle shifts in dark background shades and horizontal dividers, maintaining a cohesive dark theme.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion, implement a sticky header component that consists of two distinct rows: a top bar for branding and search, and a secondary bar for main navigation links. Both rows should maintain their fixed position at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.

The site employs a dark aesthetic by using deep blue tones for backgrounds, contrasted with light-colored text and bright, saturated yellow-orange for interactive elements and calls-to-action, ensuring high readability and visual emphasis.

The page structure uses a two-column layout for the main content area, with a dedicated right sidebar that scrolls alongside the primary content, housing supplementary information and frequently asked questions.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) with a clear hierarchy, using a consistent sans-serif font.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons, input fields, and content cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density, with ample padding around main content sections but a more compact layout for the right sidebar and footer information.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a persistent, multi-row sticky header combined with a fixed-width right sidebar creates a highly functional and information-dense layout. The dark, high-contrast color scheme with vibrant yellow accents reinforces a bold and engaging user experience, particularly suited for its industry.
